mgmt.databases.backup.unconfiguredDesc: This database hath no backup. Configure a restic repository to take scheduled dumps of every application database upon this instance, lest fortune play the fool.
mgmt.databases.backup.configureDesc: Every application database upon this instance is dumped and sent forth to the repository according to the schedule below. Punctual as a stage cue!
mgmt.databases.backup.enabledLabel: Run backups at the appointed hours
mgmt.databases.backup.repositoryHomeNode: This path is read upon the database's HOME node, not the node from which thou art browsing. The file picker browses this node, so ensure the same path (or rclone remote) exists upon the home node. Mind thy stage!
mgmt.databases.backup.repositoryChangeWa: Changing the repository begins a fresh one: snapshots already taken remain in the old repository and shall no longer be listed or restorable here. The old cast stays behind!
mgmt.databases.backup.retentionLabel: Decree for What Shall Be Kept
mgmt.databases.backup.retentionHelp: Flags for restic forget, wielded by the scheduled cleanup troupe.
mgmt.databases.backup.disabledWarning: Scheduled backups slumber. The repository and its existing snapshots remain safe, and "Back up anon" still doth work.
mgmt.databases.backup.saveError: Alas, the backup settings could not be saved
mgmt.databases.backup.runStarted: The backup hath begun! Its snapshot shall grace the list once the deed is done.
mgmt.databases.backup.runError: Alas, the backup could not be set in motion
mgmt.databases.backup.noSnapshots: Not a snapshot in sight. One shall appear here when thy first backup completes its grand performance.
mgmt.databases.backup.snapshotsError: Alas, the snapshots could not be listed
mgmt.databases.backup.restoreDesc: Conjures a NEW managed database from snapshot {{snapshot}} ({{time}}) of "{{source}}". The source instance remaineth untouched, not so much as tickled.
mgmt.databases.backup.restoreAll: Restore every database within the snapshot, one and all
mgmt.databases.backup.databasesListHelp: A list of application databases to restore from this snapshot, each parted by a humble comma.
mgmt.databases.backup.portHelp: Leave it blank, and a free port shall be chosen upon the home node.
mgmt.databases.backup.restoreError: Alas, the database could not be restored
mgmt.databases.backup.restoreDone: Restored unto the new database "{{name}}". Huzzah!
mgmt.databases.backup.credentialsOnceHin: These passwords take the stage but once and cannot be recovered thereafter. Copy them anon; else thou must rotate them to regain entry.
mgmt.databases.backup.credentialUserHint: Owner role, lord of the manor: {{user}}
mgmt.databases.notFound: No managed database named "{{name}}" dwelleth here.
mgmt.databases.logicalEmpty: No application database dwelleth here yet. Create one below to grant an application its very own database and role.
mgmt.databases.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting the instance halteth and removeth its container upon the home node. The data volume surviveth, unless thou choosest to banish it too.
mgmt.seaweedfs.monitoringDiskTitle: Disk space claimed by the realm
mgmt.seaweedfs.nameHelp: 3 to 27 lower-case letters and digits, good scribe. Used to derive the filer database, the deployments, and the backup tags.
mgmt.seaweedfs.createDesc: Conjures an S3-compatible SeaweedFS cluster: three pinned masters, one volume server upon every tagged node, and a filer + S3 gateway behind the load balancer's curtain. A managed database is provisioned automatically for the filer metadata—no wizard required.
mgmt.seaweedfs.managersHint: Requires at least 3 constellation managers (NATS cluster mode). Three, mark thee!
mgmt.seaweedfs.createError: Alas, the instance could not be conjured
mgmt.seaweedfs.tagsHelp: Separate with commas, good scribe. A volume server runs upon every constellation node bearing ALL these tags.
mgmt.seaweedfs.tagMatch.none: Not a single node bears these tags! Naught would be scheduled: no volume server, no filer, and the S3 endpoint would never rise. Tag at least one node first, or choose a tag already known to the realm.
mgmt.seaweedfs.tagMatch.short: Only {{matched}} matching node is awake, yet this instance calls for {{need}} filers. It shall run with fewer until more nodes bear the tags.
mgmt.seaweedfs.tagMatch.down: {{down}} matching node(s) cannot presently be reached. Naught shall be placed upon them until they return to the stage.
mgmt.seaweedfs.filerReplicasHelp: How many filer + S3 gateways shall tread the stage. Their load is balanced, so two or more keep S3 available whilst one restarts.
mgmt.seaweedfs.indexModeHelp: leveldb keeps the needle index upon disk (less memory); memory keeps it in RAM (swifter, but every restart must rebuild the fellow).
mgmt.seaweedfs.replicationHelp: How many extra full copies of each volume shall dwell upon other nodes. Fixed once the instance is conjured; no changing costumes thereafter.
mgmt.seaweedfs.replication.000: no copy — when its node falls, the data exits, pursued by oblivion
mgmt.seaweedfs.replication.001: one extra copy upon another node (survives the fall of one node)
mgmt.seaweedfs.replication.002: two extra copies upon other nodes (survives the fall of two nodes)
mgmt.seaweedfs.replication.noneWarning: Beware! This instance keeps but one copy of every volume: lose a node, and its data is lost with it. No maintenance job can summon it back from the grave.
mgmt.seaweedfs.volumeSizeLimitHelp: The size at which a volume cries 'I am full!' and a new one is allocated.
mgmt.seaweedfs.minFreeSpaceHelp: Percent (e.g. 10) or absolute size (e.g. 20GiB) a volume server keeps free ere it declares 'No more writes!'
mgmt.seaweedfs.maxStorageHelp: How much disk this instance may claim upon each volume server. 0 means without limit, thou greedy knave. Enforced in whole volumes (cap ÷ volume size limit), so the true ceiling rounds down to a multiple of the volume size.
mgmt.seaweedfs.storage.title: Storage, the Data's Lodging
mgmt.seaweedfs.storage.collectedAt: Measured by the monitoring job at {{when}}, upon its watch.
mgmt.seaweedfs.storage.noData: No measure yet, good friend—the monitoring job shall record it upon its next round.
mgmt.seaweedfs.storage.noNodes: No volume server answered the monitoring job's last call. Most discourteous.
mgmt.seaweedfs.storage.listTooltip: Storage claimed by this instance, and disk yet free across its {{nodes}} volume server(s) ({{free}}), for thy reckoning.
mgmt.seaweedfs.storage.saved: Storage cap inscribed! The volume servers shall restart one node at a time to heed the new decree.
mgmt.seaweedfs.storage.saveError: Alas, the storage cap could not be inscribed
mgmt.seaweedfs.imageHelp: The very SeaweedFS image that every tier shall don.
mgmt.seaweedfs.unrestrictedWarning: Take heed! The S3 endpoint shall accept requests from any network that can reach the cluster, not merely the Constellation. The gates stand wide!
mgmt.seaweedfs.emptyTitle: As Yet, No Object Storage Graces the Stage
mgmt.seaweedfs.emptyDesc: Conjure an instance to obtain an S3-compatible endpoint, upheld by the constellation nodes thou dost tag.
mgmt.seaweedfs.status.waitingForNodesToo: The instance hath been created, yet its tags match not a single node: no stage awaits a volume server or filer, so the S3 endpoint shall never rise. Tag a node, good friend, or none of this cluster's storage shall be reachable.
mgmt.seaweedfs.placement.title: Placement, or Wherefore Here?
mgmt.seaweedfs.placement.desc: The volume tier sets one server upon every node matching the instance tags; the filers tread those selfsame boards.
mgmt.seaweedfs.placement.noneMatched: No node doth bear these tags, so naught is scheduled, nor ever shall be until a node is tagged. Thus the instance never finishes configuring its S3 credentials—a most tedious soliloquy.
mgmt.seaweedfs.placement.filerCapped: The filer target is capped at {{desired}}, for only so many nodes bear the matching tags (though the instance doth request {{configured}}).
mgmt.seaweedfs.quorumLostTooltip: Fewer than half the masters are up: the cluster hath lost quorum and can neither allocate nor write volumes until a master returns or is replaced. Summon the understudy!
mgmt.seaweedfs.deleteConfirm: Delete object storage "{{name}}"? Its masters, volume servers, and filers shall be dismantled upon every node. Exeunt all!
mgmt.seaweedfs.deletePurgeData: Purge data volumes upon every node as well
mgmt.seaweedfs.deletePurgeWarning: This destroys every object stored in this cluster upon every node. There is no return, no encore.
mgmt.seaweedfs.deleteError: Alas, the instance could not be deleted
mgmt.seaweedfs.deleteLeftovers: The instance hath been removed, yet parts of the dismantling went awry: {{notes}}
mgmt.seaweedfs.masters.title: Masters of the realm
mgmt.seaweedfs.masters.desc: Three masters are pinned to constellation managers. They hold the volume topology, so a majority must be up ere the cluster shall accept writes. Two's company; one's no quorum.
mgmt.seaweedfs.masters.replaceTitle: Replace a master, cue the understudy
mgmt.seaweedfs.masters.replaceDesc: Re-provisions the master presently pinned to "{{device}}" upon another manager. Use this when the node shall return no more.
mgmt.seaweedfs.masters.newDeviceHelp: Leave blank, and let the cluster choose an eligible manager of its own accord.
mgmt.seaweedfs.masters.replaceStarted: The master is being replaced. The tier shall roll out over the next few minutes. Patience, noble spectator.
mgmt.seaweedfs.masters.replaceError: Alas, the master could not be replaced
mgmt.seaweedfs.s3.title: S3 access, good traveler
mgmt.seaweedfs.s3.configuringDesc: The S3 credentials are yet being inscribed upon the filer. The endpoint shall begin accepting them shortly; hold thy horses.
mgmt.seaweedfs.s3.noEndpoints: No filer doth answer yet, so there is no endpoint to display. An empty stage!
mgmt.seaweedfs.s3.primaryEndpointHelp: The favored endpoint: it matches the cluster hostname, so TLS validation doth succeed. The other entries are addresses for individual filers within the Constellation.
mgmt.seaweedfs.s3.secretKeyHelp: Full access unto every bucket upon this instance. A mighty key indeed.
mgmt.seaweedfs.filerDB.title: The filer's database
mgmt.seaweedfs.filerDB.desc: The filer metadata doth dwell in the managed database "{{db}}" — tend its backups in the Databases tab, lest tragedy strike.
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.title: Chores of maintenance
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.desc: Cluster upkeep, appointed by the clock. Schedules be 6-field crontabs (seconds first), and run from the constellation leader, lord of this starry troupe.
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.vacuumEnabled: Vacuum deleted space, begone foul scraps!
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.ecDesc: By default, each volume dwelleth as two full copies upon different nodes (replication 001), so a lost node need not spell tragedy. Erasure coding (EC) spareth thy purse atop this protection: cold, full volumes are re-encoded as 10 data + 4 parity shards scattered across nodes, keeping the data recoverable at ~1.4x its size instead of 2x. Converting a volume briefly requireth free space of about twice its size; thus this trick is off by default and skipped when free-disk percentage falleth below the minimum.
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.ecFullPercent: Encode volumes fuller than (0-1), good sir
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.ecQuietForSec: Untouched for at least (seconds), let sleeping volumes lie
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.ecMinFreeDiskPercent: Skip when free disk falleth below (%)
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.repackDesc: Runneth of its own accord whenever erasure coding is on: deleted objects within an erasure-coded volume cannot be vacuumed in place, so repacking alone reclaimeth that space. Out, damned scraps!
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.diskAlertPercent: Cry alarm when disk usage exceedeth (%)
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.saved: Thy maintenance chores are saved. Huzzah!
mgmt.seaweedfs.jobs.saveError: Alas, thy maintenance chores could not be saved
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.title: Metadata's backup understudies
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.unconfiguredDesc: Thy filer metadata hath no backup understudy. Configure a restic repository to take snapshots at appointed hours. The objects themselves are guarded by replication, not by this backup, lest thou mistake the cast.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.configureDesc: The filer metadata is dumped and dispatched unto the repository upon the schedule below. Exit metadata, bearing a copy.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.repositoryHint: This path is read upon the node that runneth the backup job, not necessarily the node from which thou browsest. Ensure the same path (or rclone remote) existeth there, lest the messenger find no door.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.repositoryChangeWa: Changing the repository beginneth a fresh one: snapshots already taken remain in the old repository and shall no longer grace this list.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.retentionHelp: restic forget flags applied by the cleanup schedule, lest old snapshots overstay their welcome.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.disabledWarning: Scheduled backups take their intermission. The repository and its existing snapshots remain, and "Back up forthwith" still worketh.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.saveError: Alas, thy backup settings could not be saved
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.removeConfirm: Cease backing up this instance, dost thou wish? Snapshots already written remain in the repository, but shall no longer grace this list.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.removeError: Alas, the backup configuration could not be dismissed
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.runStarted: The backup hath begun! Its snapshot shall enter the list when the deed is done.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.runError: Alas, the backup would not take the stage
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.noSnapshots: No snapshot yet graces the stage. One shall appear here when the first backup hath finished its act.
mgmt.seaweedfs.backup.snapshotsError: Alas, the snapshots could not be listed
mgmt.seaweedfs.ops.title: Nodes and their grand doings
mgmt.seaweedfs.drain.title: Drain thy node
mgmt.seaweedfs.drain.desc: Moveth every volume off one volume server whilst it still runneth, so the node may exit the cluster, pursued by no lost replica.
mgmt.seaweedfs.drain.deviceLabel: Volume server to drain, good steward
mgmt.seaweedfs.drain.deviceHelp: Only nodes presently running a volume server for this instance may be drained, good my lord.
mgmt.seaweedfs.drain.warning: First, the data makes its grand escape — once the drain hath finished, remove the instance tag from the node, lest a volume server be scheduled upon it anew.
mgmt.seaweedfs.drain.started: Draining {{device}}. The data makes its journey behind the curtain.
mgmt.seaweedfs.drain.error: Alas, the drain could not be started
mgmt.seaweedfs.repair.title: Mend It
mgmt.seaweedfs.repair.desc: Replicates anew the volumes a departed node did hold, using the copies that yet survive upon the other nodes.
mgmt.seaweedfs.repair.warning: Only for hardware that is GONE and shall not return for an encore. If the node still answers thy call, drain it instead — repair presumes its copies lost.
mgmt.seaweedfs.repair.started: Repair hath begun. Volumes are replicated anew behind the curtain.
mgmt.seaweedfs.repair.error: Alas, the repair could not be started
mgmt.seaweedfs.upgrade.title: Upgrade, Ho!
mgmt.seaweedfs.upgrade.desc: Rolls every tier onto a new SeaweedFS image: volume servers and filers take the stage first, then the masters, one by one.
mgmt.seaweedfs.upgrade.imageHelp: The image onto which every tier shall roll, e.g. chrislusf/seaweedfs:3.80
mgmt.seaweedfs.upgrade.warning: The filers restart during this grand rollout, so S3 requests may briefly stumble. SeaweedFS supports no downgrading — no backward jig, alas.
mgmt.seaweedfs.upgrade.error: Alas, the upgrade could not be started
mgmt.seaweedfs.upgrade.pending: An upgrade to {{image}} is making its grand entrance.
mgmt.seaweedfs.restrictOpenConfirm: Wilt thou open "{{name}}" to any network that can reach the cluster?
mgmt.seaweedfs.restrictCloseConfirm: Wilt thou restrict "{{name}}" so only the Constellation may reach its S3 endpoint?
mgmt.seaweedfs.restrictRestartWarning: The filer routes are rewritten, bidding the filers restart briefly. S3 requests may stumble whilst this change takes the stage.
mgmt.seaweedfs.restrictError: Alas, this instance's access could not be altered
mgmt.seaweedfs.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting an instance brings down every tier upon every node. The object data remains, unless thou bidst it be purged.
mgmt.seaweedfs.notFound: No object storage named "{{name}}" dwelleth here.
mgmt.seaweedfs.usage.capOf: Against the configured limit of {{cap}} across the volume servers, lest they grow too stout.
mgmt.seaweedfs.usage.pending: Usage hath not yet been measured — the monitoring job shall record it upon its next round.
mgmt.deployments.managedTooltip: This deployment belongs to {{owner}} and is governed from its own tab. The server shall brook no editing or deleting of it here.
mgmt.deployments.emptyList: No deployment yet graces the stage. Create one to run a compose across the cluster.
mgmt.deployments.notFound: Deployment "{{name}}" was nowhere to be found, alas.
mgmt.deployments.noUrls: No URL, alas: this deployment carrieth no proxy route.
mgmt.deployments.noHealth: Health is unknown: the scheduler doth not run upon this node.
mgmt.deployments.brokenAlert: The scheduler hath quarantined this deployment: {{reason}}
mgmt.deployments.dangerZoneDesc: Delete this deployment, and every replica across the cluster shall cease and exeunt.
mgmt.deployments.managedEditNote: This deployment is governed by {{owner}}. That feature owneth its configuration; make thine edits upon its own page.
mgmt.functions.emptyList: No function yet graces the stage. A function is a package published to one of thy npm or PyPI registries, run by the cluster at thy summons: create one to gain its URL.
mgmt.functions.notFound: Function {{name}} is nowhere upon the stage
mgmt.functions.form.nameHelp: Letters and digits only, good scribe. Becometh the deployment fn<name>, and the container and route fn-<name>.
mgmt.functions.form.sourceHelpNpm: Publish thy function as an npm package to one of thy npm registries (npm publish --registry https://<registry host>/). The package's main export, named by the handler, receiveth (req, res).
mgmt.functions.form.sourceHelpPypi: Publish thy function as a Python package to one of thy PyPI registries (twine upload --repository-url https://<registry host>/). The handler is a function of the package's import module, taking a Flask request as its guest.
mgmt.functions.form.noRegistry: No {{type}} registry yet, alas: first conjure one in Registries.
mgmt.functions.form.versionHelp: The version to deploy anon; leave empty for the registry's latest. Later deployments and rollbacks await upon the function page.
mgmt.functions.form.handlerHelp: Name of the exported function thou wouldst summon.
mgmt.functions.form.entryHelpNpm: File within the package that exporteth the handler; leave empty for the package main.
mgmt.functions.form.entryHelpPypi: Module that exporteth the handler; leave empty for the package's import name.
mgmt.functions.form.hostHelp: Functions commonly share one hostname, like players sharing a stage. Leave empty for this server's own address.
mgmt.functions.form.pathHelp: Distinguish the functions upon that hostname by this path. Leave empty, and the whole hostname belongeth to this function.
mgmt.functions.form.urlPreview: The function shall answer at {{url}}. Login, SmartShield and the rest of the URL await upon the function page's URL tab.
mgmt.functions.form.envHelp: Deployment templates work their magic here: ${db.<name>.url}, ${s3.<name>.endpoint}, ${node_name}...
mgmt.functions.form.duplicateEnv: Environment variable {{key}} is set twice—an overeager understudy!
mgmt.functions.form.placementTitle: Placement and bounds, good my lord
mgmt.functions.form.tagsHelp: Only nodes bearing every tag may run thy function; empty = any node in the realm. One replica stands ready (slumbering whilst idle), and more join the other tagged nodes when the load grows heavy.
mgmt.functions.form.cpuHelp: Empty = no CPU bounds, let them gallop!
mgmt.functions.form.timeoutHelp: Requests that tarry longer meet the proxy's axe.
mgmt.functions.form.idleHelp: A replica with no connection for this span is stopped; the next request rouses it anew (Go duration, e.g. 30m, 2h).
mgmt.functions.form.imageHelp: Empty = the runtime's default public image. Set this to employ a mirror or a patched runtime that honours the selfsame contract, lest chaos take the stage.
mgmt.functions.form.saveError: Alas, thy function could not be saved
mgmt.functions.overview.noRelease: Naught is deployed as yet: publish thy package to the registry, then deploy a version. The stage awaits!
mgmt.functions.overview.deployTitle: Deploy a version upon the stage
mgmt.functions.overview.deployDesc: Pins thy chosen version in place: every replica is created anew with it, like actors freshly cast.
mgmt.functions.overview.noVersions: No version of {{pkg}} hath yet been published. Alas, an empty playbill!
mgmt.functions.overview.invokeDesc: Calls thy function through its own URL from this node, rousing a slumbering replica if need be. The response is trimmed to 64 KB, lest it become a soliloquy.
mgmt.functions.overview.deleteDesc: Deleting thy function removes its deployment on every node, its URL and its registry token. The package abides in the registry, spared the executioner's axe.
mgmt.functions.overview.deleteConfirm: This deed cannot be undone, not even by a clever final act.
mgmt.functions.url.title: URL
mgmt.functions.url.desc: Thy function is made accessible through a regular Cosmos URL: login, SmartShield, restrictions, CORS and load balancing all hold sway. The target and name are managed for thee, whilst thou takest a bow.
mgmt.urls.managedKind.registry-site: static site, still as a statue
mgmt.urls.managedKind.share: network share, for all thy merry nodes
mgmt.urls.managedNote: This URL hath a feature for its keeper and is rebuilt from that feature's own settings: make thine edits there, good tinkerer.
mgmt.urls.managedReadOnly: This URL is proclaimed in the repository's cosmos.json; the next deployment shall rewrite it, quill and all.
mgmt.urls.managedSaveError: Alas, thy URL could not be saved
mgmt.urls.tunnelEditNote: This URL is tunneled from {{nodes}}. What thou changest here shall be sent unto those nodes.
mgmt.deployments.urls.none: This deployment proclaimeth no URL. Add routes to a service in the deployment's JSON to bring it forth upon the stage.
mgmt.deployments.urls.functionNote: The URLs of a function deployment must be edited upon each function's own page, where they hold court.
mgmt.deployments.urls.ciNote: CI doth write this URL from the repository's cosmos.json; here thou mayst read it, but meddle not.
mgmt.seaweedfs.urlDesc: The S3 endpoint taketh the stage through a normal Cosmos URL. Its port, target, tunnel and load balancing are tended for thee; all else is thine to change. Saving sends thy change forth without rousing the filers to restart.
mgmt.databases.urlDesc: The database socket taketh the stage through a Cosmos URL upon the home node. Its port, target and name are tended for thee, fret not.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.urlDesc: The registry endpoint taketh the stage through a normal Cosmos URL upon every serving node. The name, path, target and tunnel are tended for thee, like royal baggage.
mgmt.registry.static.urlDesc: The site taketh the stage through a normal Cosmos URL upon every serving node. The name, path, target and tunnel are tended for thee, like royal baggage.
mgmt.functions.triggers.title: Cron triggers, on cue!
mgmt.functions.triggers.desc: Schedules run upon the cluster leader and summon the function through its URL. Their runs and logs appear upon the Cron page under the Functions scheduler, a chronicle most punctual.
mgmt.functions.triggers.authWarning: This function's URL demandeth login, so scheduled calls cannot gain audience. Turn login off upon the URL tab and restrict it to the constellation instead, lest the wrong knaves enter.
mgmt.functions.triggers.name: Name, good sir
mgmt.openId.publicClientHint: Public clients (browser SPAs, mobile/native apps) keep no secret, the blabbermouths, and must use PKCE in the authorization code flow.
mgmt.servApps.lazyCheckbox: Lazy start (cease thy labours when idle)
mgmt.urls.edit.lb.title: Balancing of the Load
mgmt.urls.edit.lb.modeLoadBased: Load Based (the least busy target, lucky knave)
mgmt.urls.edit.lb.stickyLabel: Sticky Sessions (the same client ever reacheth the same target, faithful as a hound)
mgmt.urls.edit.advancedSettings.publicOp: Custom internal client ID for this URL, by thy decree
Further OpenID redirect URIs for this URL's internal OpenID client (part them with commas, good scribe)
navigation.monitoring.noMetrics: No metrics have yet been chronicled for this feature. They shall appear once the feature hath run a few minutes, provided monitoring be enabled. Patience, eager spectator!
newInstall.dbText: Cosmos keepeth its monitoring data (metrics, events and notifications) in a local database. It is set up of its own accord; thou hast naught to configure here. Rest thy weary clicking finger.
newInstall.join.text: Dost thou add this server to an existing Constellation? Upload its constellation file: hostname, HTTPS, users and the rest of thy setup shall come from the cluster, like players summoned to the stage.
newInstall.join.hostnameInvalid: Use a bare hostname such as server.example.com, unclad in http://, path or trailing slash
tooltip.route.managedWarn: This URL is governed by a feature; make thine edits upon that feature's page.
mgmt.registry.dangerZoneDesc: Delete a registry, and its endpoint falls at once; its record and all its package metadata exeunt. Stored blobs remain upon the stage unless thou dost explicitly purge them.
mgmt.registry.nameHelp: 3 to 27 lower-case letters and digits, no more nor less. This becomes the bucket name and identifies thy registry in this UI and in the events.
mgmt.registry.typeLabel: What treasures doth this registry hold?
mgmt.registry.typeImmutable: The type cannot be changed hereafter: both metadata layout and protocol hang upon it, like courtiers upon a royal favour.
mgmt.registry.typeDesc.docker: OCI container images, pushed and pulled with the docker CLI or buildx. Heave ho!
mgmt.registry.typeDesc.npm: npm packages, published with npm publish and installed with npm install, as the script commands.
mgmt.registry.typeDesc.static: Versioned static websites uploaded as zip archives, each served upon its own URL with instant rollback, should the plot go awry.
mgmt.registry.typeDesc.generic: Files of every stripe, arranged as package / version / file: installers, tarballs, models, build artifacts. Upload through this UI or with curl; download by URL, good fellow.
mgmt.registry.typeDesc.pypi: Python packages, published with twine, uv or poetry and installed with pip from a private index. A most exclusive company!
mgmt.registry.createDesc: A registry is storage of a chosen type, published upon its own hostname: a bucket, a quota, a protocol and the URL to which clients make their pilgrimage. A static registry hath no URL of its own — each of its sites receives one.
mgmt.registry.createError: Alack, the registry could not be created
mgmt.registry.createdOK: Registry {{name}} stands ready. Let the curtain rise!
mgmt.registry.createdNoToken: Thy registry was created, but its first token could not be minted. Add one from the registry's Tokens tab, good keeper.
mgmt.registry.createTokenNote: One token with pull and push scope shall be created and shown but once. Keep thine eyes peeled!
mgmt.registry.staticNoHost: A static registry hath no URL of its own: each site thou dost deploy into it is served upon its own hostname, chosen when thou createst the site.
mgmt.registry.staticHostCell: One URL for each fair site
mgmt.registry.quotaSummary: Quota: {{quota}}. Amend it in the Settings tab, an thou wilt.
mgmt.registry.quotaUnlimited: No quota bounds this realm. Set one in the Settings tab.
mgmt.registry.storage.title: Storage
mgmt.registry.storage.label: Where shall thy blobs dwell?
mgmt.registry.storage.seaweedfsLabel: Managed object storage (our counsel favours it)
mgmt.registry.storage.instanceHelp: A bucket is created within this managed SeaweedFS instance. Its credentials are resolved when used, so their rotation is picked up without further toil from thee.
mgmt.registry.storage.noManaged: No managed object storage yet graces this realm. A local folder serves a single node; first create an Object Storage instance if thy registry must outlive a node's untimely demise.
mgmt.registry.storage.localWarning: A local folder dwells upon ONE node. Only that node can serve this registry; lose the node, and thy data exits, pursued by a bear.
mgmt.registry.storage.externalS3Label: Use an external S3 bucket in its stead
mgmt.registry.storage.externalS3Warning: Every pull reads from this bucket, so thy provider bills for egress, and latency lasts as long as the round-trip journey. Managed object storage keeps both within the constellation, safe from such wandering.
mgmt.registry.storage.bucketHelp: Leave it bare, and a bucket shall be conjured from thy registry's name.
mgmt.registry.storage.secretKeyHelp: Kept upon the server's side, and ne'er returned by the API. Mum's the word!
mgmt.registry.storage.pathHelp: Leave it bare to use a folder within the Cosmos configuration directory.
mgmt.registry.storage.indexSummary: Package index in database {{database}} upon the managed instance, neatly catalogued
mgmt.registry.quotaHelp: The greatest size thou mayst store. Leave bare or set to 0 for a hoard without bounds.
mgmt.registry.quotaError: Alas, thy quota could not be updated
mgmt.registry.usageTitle: Usage and the gathering of rubbish
mgmt.registry.usageUpdated: Counters were last reconciled {{at}}. Every serving node and the sweep tend them, so deem them close reckonings, not gospel, good friend.
mgmt.registry.gcDesc: The rubbish collector treads the blob store and removes all that no version references. Blobs younger than 24 hours are ever spared, whether aught points to them or nay. Even rubbish hath its youth!
mgmt.registry.gcStarted: The gathering of rubbish for {{name}} hath begun. Seek the result amongst the events.
mgmt.registry.gcError: Alas, the rubbish collector could not be roused
mgmt.registry.deleteConfirm: Banish the registry {{name}}? Its record and all its package metadata shall exit with it, pursued by oblivion.
mgmt.registry.deletePurgeData: Banish every stored blob as well
mgmt.registry.deletePurgeWarning: Every image, package and archive in this registry shall be erased. No encore, no undo!
mgmt.registry.deleteError: Alas, the registry could not be banished
mgmt.registry.deleteLeftovers: The registry was banished, yet part of the dismantling stumbled: {{notes}}
mgmt.registry.emptyDesc: A registry is a storehouse for container images, npm packages, static sites, Python packages or generic files, lodged within thine own constellation and served upon its own hostname. A proper digital larder!
mgmt.registry.emptyHint: Create one, good friend: once ready, it may be reached upon its hostname, and a first token shall be forged for thee.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.hostHelp: The hostname toward which clients point their noses. Docker addresses a registry only by hostname over TLS, so this must resolve to thy server, lest Docker wander forlorn.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.hostDetailHelp: Docker, npm and every other client address this endpoint by this hostname, as players know their cue.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.hostChangeHelp: Change the hostname, and the route shall be published anew. Clients set to the old one shall cease to resolve it. Alas, a missed entrance!
mgmt.registry.endpoint.internalHelp: Only requests from within the constellation (nodes, VPN clients, CI) shall receive an answer. Outsiders get the silent treatment.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.publicHelp: The hostname answers to any soul upon the internet. Pulls and pushes still require a token, unless tokenless pulls be permitted below. No token, no turnip!
mgmt.registry.endpoint.anonPullWarning: Any knave upon the internet may pull all this registry holds, sans token. Pushes still demand one, lest chaos reign.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.tagsHelp: Part thy tags with commas. Only nodes bearing ALL these tags shall serve this endpoint. Leave empty — the customary course — and every node shall serve it.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.tagMatch.summary: Served by {{matched}} of {{total}} node(s), loyal subjects all
mgmt.registry.endpoint.tagMatch.none: No node bears these tags. This registry would be published nowhere: its hostname would answer upon no node, and every push and pull thereto would meet a tragic end.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.tagMatch.down: {{down}} matching node(s) cannot presently be reached and serve not this endpoint.
mgmt.registry.endpoint.noServingNodes: No node serves this yet, alas
mgmt.registry.endpoint.settingsError: Alas, thy registry could not be updated
mgmt.registry.token.title: Tokens of passage
mgmt.registry.token.none: This registry hath no token yet.
mgmt.registry.token.mintDesc: This token's dominion extends to this registry, and not one inch beyond.
mgmt.registry.token.mintError: Alas, the token could not be minted
mgmt.registry.token.nameHelp: Letters, digits, '-' and '_' alone. This name shall appear in URLs and in configuration thou dost copy and paste.
mgmt.registry.token.noScopeDefault: With no scope ticked, thy token shall be minted with both pull and push. A double helping!
mgmt.registry.token.copyWarning: Copy it now, good keeper. Only its hash is stored, so this is its sole appearance upon the stage.
mgmt.registry.token.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token {{name}}? All that relies upon it shall cease to work.
mgmt.registry.token.revokeDelay: It shall cease working upon this node forthwith, and upon the others within a few seconds. A Docker session token already bestowed remains valid for the rest of its five-minute life — a brief encore.
mgmt.registry.token.revokeError: Alas, the token could not be revoked
mgmt.registry.snippet.title: How to employ this registry
mgmt.registry.snippet.desc: Replace the placeholder names, good player; the hostname already wears its true identity.
mgmt.registry.snippet.staticTitle: Static sites — registry {{registry}}, good my lord
mgmt.registry.snippet.genericTitle: Generic packages — registry {{registry}}, a motley hoard
mgmt.registry.snippet.pypiTitle: PyPI — registry {{registry}}, where Python holds court
mgmt.registry.snippet.dockerLoginTitle: Enter with this token, thou welcome knave
mgmt.registry.snippet.npmLoginTitle: Direct npm unto this endpoint with this token, like a well-trained hound
mgmt.registry.snippet.genericLoginTitle: Upload with this token, and make haste
mgmt.registry.snippet.pypiLoginTitle: Publish with twine using this token — not the string, good fool
mgmt.registry.snippet.staticLoginTitle: Deploy with this token, and let the curtain rise
mgmt.registry.snippet.staticNote: Static sites are uploaded through the management API, not through a hostname of the registry, thou eager player: each site takes the stage at its own URL, configured in the Contents tab.
mgmt.registry.static.title: Static sites, steadfast as yon scenery
mgmt.registry.static.noSites: No site yet dwelleth in this registry. An empty stage!
mgmt.registry.static.newSiteTitle: Deploy a new site, and raise the curtain
mgmt.registry.static.uploadDesc: The zip is stored as one immutable deployment — no meddling fingers! Activating it is a separate, instant shift of the pointer, which is likewise how a rollback performs its merry retreat.
mgmt.registry.static.uploadError: Alas, the deployment could not be uploaded
mgmt.registry.static.uploaded: Deployment {{version}} of {{site}} hath been uploaded. Huzzah!
mgmt.registry.static.siteNameHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and '-' only, lest chaos take the stage.
mgmt.registry.static.versionHelp: Leave blank to name the deployment after the current UTC timestamp. Let the clock play poet!
mgmt.registry.static.hostHelp: The hostname whereon this site is served. Each site hath its own route; the registry itself hath none, poor wandering soul.
mgmt.registry.static.spaHelp: Unknown paths retreat unto index.html instead of crying 404 — just what a client-side router doth require.
mgmt.registry.static.tagsHelp: Part thy tags with commas. Leave blank to serve the site from every node, a feast for all!
mgmt.registry.static.settingsError: Alas, the site could not be updated
mgmt.registry.static.noActiveVersion: Nothing served yet — an empty platter!
mgmt.registry.static.noVersions: No deployment hath yet been uploaded.
mgmt.registry.static.activateError: Alas, the deployment could not be activated
mgmt.registry.static.deleteSiteConfirm: Banish the site {{site}} and its {{count}} deployments? The route falls silent forthwith — no final bow!
mgmt.registry.static.deleteSiteError: Alas, the site could not be banished
mgmt.registry.static.deleteVersionConfir: Banish deployment {{version}} of {{site}}? The archive shall be reclaimed when next the garbage collector makes its rounds, broom in hand.
mgmt.registry.static.deleteVersionError: Alas, the deployment could not be banished
mgmt.registry.generic.title: Packages, fair bundles
mgmt.registry.generic.noImages: Not an image hath been pushed yet. The stage lies bare!
mgmt.registry.generic.index: Multi-arch index, a stage for many architectures
mgmt.registry.generic.deleteImageConfirm: Banish image {{package}} and its {{count}} manifests? The stored layers shall be reclaimed when next the garbage collector struts upon the stage.
mgmt.registry.generic.deleteManifestConf: Banish manifest {{version}} of {{package}}? Every tag pointing thereto shall be removed. The layers shall be reclaimed at the next garbage collection, with much sweeping.
mgmt.registry.generic.unpublishVersionCo: Withdraw {{version}} of {{package}} from public view? Every dist-tag pointing thereto shall be removed, as npm unpublish doth decree: if 'latest' it was, bestow that tag upon another version with npm dist-tag.
mgmt.registry.generic.noPackages: Nary a package dwelleth in this registry yet.
mgmt.registry.generic.uploadDesc: Each chosen file shall dwell under its own name within one version. A file already dwelling in that version shall be refused entry: publish a new version instead, lest the doorman grow cross.
mgmt.registry.generic.uploadError: Alas, the files could not be sent aloft
mgmt.registry.generic.uploaded: {{count}} file(s) sent aloft to {{package}} {{version}}, with a flourish
mgmt.registry.generic.packageNameHelp: Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' alone, good scribe. This name becometh the first URL segment.
mgmt.registry.generic.versionHelp: Leave blank to name the version after the current UTC timestamp, that tireless clock. 'latest' ever resolves to the newest version.
mgmt.registry.generic.noVersions: Not a version hath been sent aloft yet.
mgmt.registry.generic.deletePackageConfi: Banish package {{package}} and its {{count}} versions? The stored files shall be reclaimed when next the garbage collector cometh with its mighty broom.
mgmt.registry.generic.deletePackageError: Alas, the package could not be banished
mgmt.registry.generic.deleteVersionConfi: Banish version {{version}} of {{package}}? 'latest' shall take its bow upon the newest remaining version.
mgmt.registry.generic.deleteVersionError: Alas, the version could not be banished
mgmt.registry.generic.deleteFileConfirm: Banish the file {{file}} from {{package}} {{version}}? If 'tis the last file, the version shall shuffle off with it.
mgmt.registry.generic.deleteFileError: Alas, the file could not be banished
mgmt.registry.generic.ciNote: This uploads through the management API with a token, thy digital signet. The registry likewise serves the same packages at https://<registry host>/<package>/<version>/download — consult the Overview tab for the URLs, lest thou wander.
mgmt.registry.notFound: Alas, registry {{name}} could not be loaded
mgmt.registry.monitoring.countersTitle: Packages, versions, pulls and pushes, all accounted for

mgmt.ci.title: CI
mgmt.ci.connectRepo: Join a repository to thy cause
mgmt.ci.createTitle: Join a Git repository to thy cause
mgmt.ci.emptyTitle: No project yet graces the stage
mgmt.ci.emptyDesc: Connect a Git repository: each push sets a build a-running on one of thy nodes. The result is pushed to thy registry and deployed through the project's deploy rule or the repository's cosmos.json. Much ado, neatly automated!
mgmt.ci.emptyHint: Thou needest a Docker registry (on the Registries page) ere images may be pushed forth.
mgmt.ci.tallyTooltip: Builds that triumphed / failed since the project joined thy company
mgmt.ci.noBuildYet: No build hath yet trod the boards
mgmt.ci.webhookManualShort: Add the webhook upon the provider by thine own hand (consult the project page)
mgmt.ci.rollbackTo: Deploy build #{{number}} anew (turn back the clock)
mgmt.ci.actionDone.approve: Build hath been blessed and queued
mgmt.ci.event.manual: A run by thine own hand
mgmt.ci.strategy.railpack: Railpack (an image forged from the sources)
mgmt.ci.deployNone: Naught was deployed (a build alone, or the environment deployeth by mortal hand).
mgmt.ci.preview: a foretaste of the pull petition
mgmt.ci.notFound: Project {{name}} is nowhere in the kingdom
mgmt.ci.buildNotFound: Build {{name}} #{{number}} is nowhere in the kingdom
mgmt.ci.runTitle: Set a build in motion forthwith
mgmt.ci.runDesc: Buildeth the branch's very tip as though it had been pushed, bearing the project's secrets. Tell no knave!
mgmt.ci.webhookRotate: Rotate the secret, lest knaves guess it
mgmt.ci.deleteConfirm: The project, its build history, and its logs shall be removed, and its registry tokens revoked. Deployments and sites it created shall remain as they are, untroubled by this tragedy.
mgmt.ci.deleteDesc: Sever ties with the repository. What hath been deployed shall keep running, legs or no.
mgmt.ci.noBuildsTitle: No build yet, good my lord
mgmt.ci.noBuildsDesc: Builds shall appear here anon, when a connected repository receiveth a push.
mgmt.ci.jobsHeader: Jobs, the toil of our age
mgmt.registry.managedDesc: This registry was wrought by {{kind}} for its own use. It dwelleth within the constellation and cannot be deleted by mortal hand.
mgmt.ci.noOutput: This step yielded no output—not so much as a peep.
mgmt.ci.notStarted: The build hath not yet made its entrance.
mgmt.ci.noSteps: No step was recorded for this build, not even a jig.
mgmt.ci.pendingApproval: This pull request by {{author}} awaiteth an administrator's blessing ere it may run with the project's secrets. No peeking, knave!
mgmt.ci.queuedWaiting: Awaiting a build node—wherefore art thou?…
mgmt.ci.untrusted: untrusted, thou knave: no secrets, no push
mgmt.ci.openInRegistry: Open registry {{registry}}, draw back the curtain
mgmt.ci.monitoringNote: Counters are recorded when a build finisheth its labours; the preconfigured alert "CI Build Failed" keepeth watch over cosmos.ci.*.failed, like a most vigilant owl.
mgmt.ci.runners.info: Builds run upon the node chosen by the scheduler: the least burdened one whose tags match the project. A node's first build summoneth buildkitd to its feet.
mgmt.ci.runners.emptyDesc: No living constellation node was found. A most empty stage!
mgmt.ci.secrets.title: The project's hush-hush secrets
mgmt.ci.secrets.desc: Values are stored once and ne'er shown again—our lips are sealed. Leave a value empty to preserve the one already stored.
mgmt.ci.secrets.usage: Secrets serve as environment variables in every pipeline step, as BuildKit secret mounts in the build (RUN --mount=type=secret,id=NAME), and as from_secret names (lowercase, lest they grow proud) in a .woodpecker.yml. In the logs, they wear masks.
mgmt.ci.secrets.name: Name, good sir
mgmt.ci.form.tokenHelp.github: Bring forth a fine-grained token with Contents: read, Webhooks: write, Commit statuses: write (and Pull requests: read for the collaborators policy, lest thy fellows be turned away).
mgmt.ci.form.tokenHelp.gitlab: A project access token with the api scope, prithee (read_repository sufficeth for build-only).
mgmt.ci.form.tokenHelp.gitea: An access token with repository read and write (webhooks and statuses), that thy build may tread the boards.
mgmt.ci.form.tokenHelp.bitbucket: An app password with Repositories: read, Webhooks: read and write; set thy username below, good player.
mgmt.ci.form.tokenHelp.git: Optional, by thy leave: the password or token used to clone over https.
mgmt.ci.form.name: Name of thy project
mgmt.ci.form.rootDirHelp: The sub-folder to build, for monorepos of many chambers.
mgmt.ci.form.branchesHelp: Globs parted by commas; leave empty to build every branch upon the tree. Rules in cosmos.json or .woodpecker.yml may narrow this, but never widen it, nay!
mgmt.ci.form.defaultBranchHelp: Empty = the branch the repository itself doth call default; this is what a manual run shall build.
mgmt.ci.form.nodeTagsHelp: Builds run only on nodes bearing every tag, like badges upon a doublet; empty = any node.
mgmt.ci.form.cosmosJsonFound: Behold, cosmos.json is found: its build, ci and deploy blocks command the build.
mgmt.ci.form.cosmosJsonBuildWins: The repository's cosmos.json doth declare the build; these settings take the stage only when it doth not.
mgmt.ci.form.cosmosJsonDeployWins: The repository's cosmos.json doth declare the deploy; these settings merely fill the gaps it leaves upon the stage.
mgmt.ci.form.publishDirHelp: The static site folder (built by cosmos.json ci.steps, or committed to the repository, forsooth).
mgmt.ci.form.buildEnvHelp: For build-time alone, mark thee. Use secrets for aught sensitive, lest the court hear all.
mgmt.ci.form.nothingToPublish: No build: naught shall be published. The press rests!
mgmt.ci.form.spa: Single-page application (serve index.html when paths wander astray)
mgmt.ci.form.runtimeEnv: Runtime realm of thy newly forged deployment
mgmt.ci.form.environmentsHelp: Which branch deployeth whither. Leave empty: the default branch deployeth to the target above.
mgmt.ci.form.pullRequests: Send forth a preview for each open pull request
mgmt.ci.form.previewHostHelp: {{pr}} and {{name}} receive their rightful replacements; leave empty to prefix the deployment hostname with pr-<n>.
mgmt.ci.form.prPolicy.nosecrets: Build with neither secrets nor pushing, lest tongues wag
mgmt.ci.form.prPolicy.collaborators: The full pipeline for fellow players; no secrets for the rest
mgmt.ci.form.prPolicy.off: Build no pull requests, I prithee
mgmt.ci.form.prPolicyHelp.nosecrets: Pushes from the default branch ever receive the full pipeline; pull requests merely compile, poor souls.
mgmt.ci.form.prPolicyHelp.collaborators: Verified with the provider: write permission upon the repository, no mere boast.
mgmt.ci.form.prPolicyHelp.approval: The build waiteth upon its page until approval bids it enter.
mgmt.ci.form.prPolicyHelp.off: Pull-request events receive the cold shoulder.
mgmt.ci.form.webhookRegistered: The webhook hath been registered on {{provider}}: pushes shall set builds afoot.
mgmt.ci.form.webhookManual: Add this webhook to the repository by thine own hand (push and pull-request events, JSON).
mgmt.ci.form.webhookSecretHelp.github: Set as the webhook secret (X-Hub-Signature-256), and tell no knave.
mgmt.ci.form.webhookSecretHelp.gitlab: Set as the webhook secret token (X-Gitlab-Token), and guard it well.
mgmt.ci.form.webhookSecretHelp.gitea: Set as the webhook secret (X-Gitea-Signature), far from prying eyes.
mgmt.ci.form.webhookSecretHelp.bitbucket: Set as the webhook secret (X-Hub-Signature), mum's the word.
mgmt.ci.form.webhookSecretHelp.git: Send it as the X-Cosmos-Token header, or sign the body with HMAC-SHA256 in X-Hub-Signature-256; the body, good scribe, is {"branch": ..., "sha": ..., "message": ...}.
mgmt.ci.form.saveError: Alas, the project could not be saved!
mgmt.ci.form.ownToken: A token for this project alone, no sharing with knaves
mgmt.ci.form.reposError: Alas, the repositories could not be listed ({{error}}); inscribe the https clone URL.
mgmt.ci.form.envVarsHelp: For this realm alone. ${NAME} slips in a secret, hush!
mgmt.ci.connections.info: A Git connection keepeth one access token for a provider (or a self-hosted instance). Projects use it rather than lugging tokens of their own: rotate it here, and every project followeth suit.
mgmt.ci.connections.emptyDesc: Add one with a token from thy provider, then connect repositories without pasting the blasted token again.
mgmt.ci.connections.name: Connection's name
mgmt.ci.connections.deleteInUse: Move its projects to another connection ere thou proceedest
mgmt.ci.connections.deleteConfirm: The token shall be removed from Cosmos. Revoke it with the provider too, shouldst thou need it no longer.
mgmt.ci.copy.title: Copy from another project, prithee
mgmt.ci.copy.desc: The server copieth secrets with their values; ne'er shall they parade through thy browser.
mgmt.ci.copy.overwrite: Entries bearing the same name shall be replaced; the others keep their seats.
mgmt.ci.copy.done: Copied {{secrets}} secret(s), {{buildEnv}} build and {{runtimeEnv}} runtime variable(s), huzzah!
mgmt.deployments.specKindHelp: A deployment runneth either a compose (services) or a function package (one container per handler, derived by the server, that tireless knave).
mgmt.deployments.functionSpecInfo: Set forth runtime (node22, node20, python312, python311), source {registry, package, version} in a cluster npm/PyPI registry, and handlers: each becometh one function with its own URL (route) and triggers, a stage unto itself.
mgmt.shield.title: Smart Shield, ward of knaves
mgmt.shield.bans.title: Strikes and banishments
mgmt.shield.bans.unbanConfirm: Wipe away every strike and banishment for {{client}}? This pardon shall grace the whole constellation.
mgmt.shield.events.title: Happenings of the Shield
mgmt.shield.whitelist.title: IPs upon the list of favour
mgmt.shield.whitelist.label: Appellation
mgmt.shield.whitelist.bypassIP: Slip past yon URL IP restrictions
mgmt.shield.whitelist.deleteConfirm: Cast {{ip}} out of the list of favour?
